notes.title: Patch (1.063)
notes.notes:
Release Date February 22, 2019
[list]
[*]Added difficulty selection menu.
On an easy difficulty level, immortal enemies are disabled and will appear only in one of the endings.
[/list]

[*] Minor fixes for collisions with rails at the second station.
[/list]

notes.title: Tunnels of Despair Released!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! I am very happy to finally anounce that the game is finally released!!! I hope you will enjoy it! It took almost two years for me to complete without any help from publisher as a One-man-Developer. It was a pretty hard path for me and I feel like I finally did it. We finally did it! I am looking forward to receive the feedback from you all and I hope you like it a lot! Best regards BearFighter! Have fun!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XMmPASr.gif[/img]

notes.title: Tunnels of Despair release date
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! I sincerily apologize for the another delay of the release. I just had to move the release date, because I could't properly test the changes, added in the last two month and various bugs revealed during the testing.

Change list:
[list]
[*]Added notes revealing the lore of the game.
[*]Hunger system rewamped.
[*]Added the ability to send ingame feedback via STOMT system. This would allow to make patches, based on the player feedback.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31322826/e6654adee8f02fb8d3d72329dcf138ae84ade68d.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MSgoRBc.gif[/img]
